AuthorExport.description: Everything a project stores for one author id, oldest first: the answer to a player's access or portability request.

flag.description: p at or above this value recommends at least Flag.

hide.description: p at or above this value recommends at least Hide.

block.description: p at or above this value recommends Block.

CategoryThresholds.description:
Per-category probability thresholds. A null level means that level is not used for the category.
Plain settable properties so the API can persist the object as JSON (projects.thresholds).

CreateKeyResponse.description: The secret is returned exactly once.

request_id.description: Client-generated id; the same id within 10 minutes replays the same response.

rules.description: When present, replaces the project's saved allow/block/context rules (send the full list).

ProjectTestRequest.description: Body of POST /api/projects/{projectId}/test. Draft values replace the saved ones for this call only.

QuotaView.description: Rolling 30-UTC-day usage of the organization in model verdicts (decision 2026-09-22): block-rule hits, degraded answers, test keys and replays are not counted.

score_weight.description: Share of the severity taken from the model Score (0..1); the rest comes from verdicts.

SeverityWeights.description:
Weights for SeverityCalculator. Config, not code: the API loads these from
appsettings (Moderation:Severity) and projects may override them in their thresholds JSON.

severity_block.description: Severity (0..3) at or above which the action is Block.

flag_below_score_confidence.description: When the model's Score confidence is below this, the action is at least Flag.

clear_severity_weights.description: Set to true to remove the project severity-weight override.

UsageDayDto.description: Model verdicts on one UTC day: the metered counter, the same source as the quota and the Polar usage events.
